categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Newtouch Software Co., Ltd. primarily operates in IT solutions, software development outsourcing, IT product sales, and innovative business services. The company focuses on providing software development, system integration, and digital transformation services mainly to financial institutions such as banks and insurance companies, as well as other industries including telecommunications, automotive, and government sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including big data, artificial intelligence (AI), cloud computing, blockchain, and mobile internet. It has developed proprietary technologies such as the Newtouch Insurance Data Warehouse Model (IDWM), heterogeneous big data one-stop processing technology (NBD Oneclick), financial knowledge corpus technology, and the Newtouch AI platform. The company employs agile development and DevOps methodologies, microservices architecture, and has built AI large models using MoE (Mixture of Experts) technology with 98 billion parameters, integrating trillion-level industry data for enhanced inference accuracy and speed.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily financial institutions including major insurance companies (China Pacific Insurance, China Life Insurance, People's Insurance Company of China, Taikang Insurance, New China Life Insurance, China Continent Property Insurance) and banks (China Construction Bank, Ping An Bank). The company also serves telecommunications, automotive, government, research institutes, and overseas clients. The financial sector, especially insurance and banking, constitutes the largest market segment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and registered office in Shanghai. It has subsidiaries and operations in major Chinese cities including Beijing, Chengdu, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Wuhan, Chongqing, and overseas presence in Japan through wholly-owned subsidiaries. Domestic operations dominate revenue, with a small portion from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Newtouch Software operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT industry supply chain, focusing on software development, IT service provision, and digital transformation solutions. It acts as a technology service provider and system integrator rather than a hardware manufacturer or raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on embracing artificial intelligence, especially generative AI and large language models, to drive innovation and digital transformation in its core markets. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI platforms, PaaS cloud platforms, big data, blockchain, and privacy computing. The company aims to deepen AI integration in financial services, automotive, judicial, and retail sectors, and expand its IT service, flow, and shared technology businesses. It also emphasizes building an AI ecosystem through partnerships with major internet and AI model providers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of IT solutions, software development services, software outsourcing, IT product sales, and innovative digital business platforms. The company uses a combination of service contracts, project-based billing, subscription-like SaaS services, and platform usage fees. It secures orders primarily via direct sales, competitive bidding, and business negotiations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Newtouch Software is positioned as a leading domestic software and IT service provider with strong brand recognition and market share in the insurance and banking IT solution sectors. It competes with other software service providers in China’s financial IT market, leveraging its proprietary technologies and long-term strategic customer relationships. The company maintains a competitive edge through continuous innovation and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.995 billion, representing an 18.57% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 8.09 million, a significant decline due to increased R&D and sales expenses related to AI investments and stock-based compensation. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.1 billion, growing nearly 15% from the previous year. R&D investment accounted for 8.85% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation despite profit pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its deep industry expertise, especially in financial services, and its proprietary core technologies that enable tailored, high-quality IT solutions. Its AI-driven platforms and large-scale data processing capabilities provide differentiated value by enhancing operational efficiency, compliance, and customer engagement for clients. The integration of AI large models, cloud computing, and big data analytics into its products and services positions it as a technology leader facilitating clients’ digital and intelligent transformation.
